summary_title: From Solana KOL to Hyperliquid conviction: inflation, alignment, and why hype wins
summary_description: George explains why he holds Hyperliquid over Solana, the deflation thesis, and what would break his conviction.

key_moments.label: Host introduces George as active Hyperliquid ecosystem voice
George's crypto origin story: paper trading, lost it all, 401k YOLO
Burned out by 2024 euphoria, took a year off crypto, came back healthier
First encountered Hyperliquid via Frog, parked six figures in HLP vault, 20-30% returns
Price down, people bitter, realized Hyperliquid was only thing worth allocating to outside Bitcoin
Hyperliquid as wealth redistribution machine, rewarding early users like Facebook never did
Why own hype over sol: solved inflation problem, token accrues all value, no VC debt
For those who think they missed it: winners average winners in bull markets, buybacks compound

pull_quote: Hyperliquid is the very best example of wealth redistribution from early users to a business, rewarding those most critical users at most critical time of growth.
